The '''Power Chief''' was a section chief position aboard [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The chief oversaw the Secondary Engineering section of the ship, which was responsible for the power, maintenance, and repair of the vessel. The Power Chief was usually an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of at least [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] rank. The chief reported to the [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]] administratively, and the [[Operations officer/Legends|Operations Officer]] functionally.<ref name="FOP" />
